title: test(dogfood): build the commit revert cases' publish fixtures in hooks, so each case's clock times the revert it pins
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbNTugWasvhTMrtCZiFGrZYK)_
Fixes #34271
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：只改一个 dogfood 测试文件。两个用例在用例体内现场发布对象来造夹具，现把这些发布移到嵌套 describe 的 beforeAll 里，断言一字未改。
- 为什么改：合并队列里该文件的「可写包的编辑提交原位恢复」用例三次超时（5.0–5.1 秒，默认 5 秒上限），把三条 PR 踢出队列。测量证明是慢 runner 上的计时悬崖，不是产品变慢。
- 风险与回滚：只动测试，产品代码与已发布包零改动；回滚就是 revert 这一个提交。用例的 5 秒上限没有放宽。
- 先看：`packages/qa/dogfood/test/package-commit-revert-path-package.dogfood.test.ts` 末尾的嵌套 describe（编辑提交夹具），以及第四个用例外层的嵌套 describe（已卸载包夹具）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run --project isolated --reporter=verbose test/package-commit-revert-path-package.dogfood.test.ts`，预期 12/12 通过，末尾用例约 0.7 秒（原约 2.6–3.0 秒）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`packages/qa/dogfood/test/package-commit-revert-path-package.dogfood.test.ts` only (a private package; nothing publishes, hence `skip-changeset`).

- `[#29414] control: a writable package's edit commit restores its own row in place`: its two object publishes (the create, then the edit that records the edit commit) move into the `beforeAll` of a nested `describe`, with a 60 s hook budget. The case now times the revert it pins and the label read after it.
- `an uninstalled package's commit is refused 404 …`: the package create and its object publish move the same way. The uninstall, both refusals and every read stay in the case.
- Every assertion is unchanged, and so is the order the suite writes state in: each nested suite runs at the position its case had. No per-case timeout is raised, and nothing is skipped or quarantined.

## Diagnosis: (a) a load/timing cliff, not a product regression and not a conflict between the roots

<details><summary>Failing queue builds: the reason line is a timeout, in the same case each time</summary>

Every one fails in `Dogfood Regression Gate (3/3)` with `Error: Test timed out in 5000ms.` at line 370, the last case of the file:

| queue build | edit-commit control | uninstalled case | B-rollback control (1 publish) | file |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 43795201091 (root) | **5098 ms ×** | 3845 ms | 1725 ms | 35.1 s |
| 43792843358 (independent) | **5013 ms ×** | 4020 ms | 1853 ms | 36.9 s |
| 43797161496 (inherited) | **5068 ms ×** | 4251 ms | 2041 ms | 37.4 s |

None of the roots touches the file, and the cases with no publish in them stay at 40–190 ms in the same runs.
</details>

<details><summary>Green history: the case's cost follows the runner's speed, and its ratio to a one-publish control does not move</summary>

The edit-commit control on green runs (scheduled `main` and queue builds, shard that ran the file):

- 11-04 to 11-13 (8 scheduled runs): 2261 to 3155 ms.
- 11-14 to 11-16 (12 runs): 2244 to 4493 ms. Fast runners on the newest trees read 2244 ms (`7be32d39fa`) and 2488 ms (`9efb58f1ca`, a later tree than the failing builds), the same as 11-06's 2350 ms.
- Its ratio to the one-publish `B rolls back` control stays 2.2 to 2.6 on every run read, so the product did not get slower on this path. What changed is runner load: the file's total runs from 18 s to 37 s across runners.
</details>

<details><summary>Local measurement (shared 4-core box, under the verify lock; absolutes are shared-box seconds, ratios carry)</summary>

Per-call wall of the edit-commit control on `origin/main` (instrumented copy, three runs):

- `publish-drafts` (create): 974 / 1221 / 1476 ms
- `publish-drafts` (edit): 1034 / 1152 / 1478 ms
- the revert under test: 526 / 582 / 700 ms
- all reads: 11 to 17 ms each

So about 80 % of the case's clock went to the two fixture publishes. The uninstalled case is similar: the package create took 517 to 597 ms and the object publish 1081 to 1236 ms, against 521 to 596 ms for the uninstall.

| case | origin/main alone ×2 | this PR alone ×2 | loaded (4 workers, both files plus 2 neighbours) |
|---|---|---|---|
| edit-commit control | 2611 / 3046 ms | 678 / 655 ms | 3750 → 761 ms |
| uninstalled case | 2226 / 2537 ms | 658 / 612 ms | 2567 → 651 ms |
| B-rollback control (untouched) | 1178 / 1195 ms | 1211 / 1286 ms | 1421 / 1446 ms |

At the failing builds' runner factor (about 1.7 to 1.9 times local alone), the edit-commit control comes out at about 1.2 to 1.4 s against its 5 s clock, which was 5.0 to 5.1 s before. The hook does the two publishes: 2.0 to 3.0 s locally, so about 5 s at that factor, inside its 60 s budget. The file's top-level hook keeps its own 180 s.
</details>

## Tests

<details><summary>Ablation: the moved fixture still feeds a pin that bites</summary>

The forbidden behaviour is the one that `[#29414]` closed: a revert restoring a row other than the committing package's own row. It was put back in the built `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` `dist/index.js`, which is the file the dogfood isolated project resolves for that package. That file is untracked build output, so no source file was touched. The `restoreVersion` call's `packageId: commitPackageId,` became `packageId: null`. On disk, the marker count went to 1 and the anchor count went from 2 to 1.

- Run: `vitest run --project isolated -t 'restores its own row in place'` (the top-level hook and the new nested hook both ran).
- Result, red:

```text
AssertionError: expected 'A edited 2' to be 'A edited 1' // Object.is equality
Tests  1 failed | 11 skipped (12)
```

- Restored from the saved copy. The sha256 equals the pre-mutation copy (`829c9eb0…`), and the marker count is 0.
- Observation: under that mutation the case's status, `success` and `action: 'restored'` pins still pass. The label read is the pin that catches it, and it is kept as it was.
</details>

## Verification

<details><summary>Local gate subset</summary>

- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the file: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on HEAD `e863d61b84` derived 53 commands, and each one was run with its exit code captured before any pipe. Results are in the report on the card.
- `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` answers PREREQUISITE NOT MET (exit 3, unbuilt packages outside this diff), so it is NOT MEASURED locally and left to CI.
- `test:repo`, the full dogfood battery and every CI family are left to CI. Their check-runs are cited in the report.
</details>
